description:
When an extension calls api.register_tool.(spec), the tool must be added to the live agent session. In build_ui_context / bind_core, wire register_tool to call OctoPi.Agent.add_tool(session, spec) so the new tool is available for the next turn.

Note: api.register_tool is already a field on API.t() and tested; this ticket adds the runtime side in Interactive.
Affected files: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex, apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/api.ex
title: Register extension tools with the agent session
